changeNote: Oct 8: Aave's USDC deposit APY (Ethereum Core / Main market) moved from 4.18% to 7.15% as borrowing demand pushed the market to about 86% utilization; this variable onchain rate can drop quickly. No other rate moved.

providers.name: X Money
providers.requirements: Premium+ subscription, or $1,000 in qualifying deposits within 34 days for 6.00% APY.
providers.details: Rolling out to select US users aged 18+. No interest for New York residents. Qualifying deposits include eligible ACH direct deposits and X creator payouts. Subscription fees may reduce earnings.
providers.protection: Pass-through FDIC eligibility through Cross River Bank and sweep program banks; conditions and aggregate limits apply.

fdic.label: FDIC · Conditional
fdic.summary: Pass-through coverage through partner banks; sweep program conditions apply.

providers.name: Cash App
providers.requirements: Green status: $300 in qualifying deposits or $500 in qualifying purchases per month.
providers.details: Savings yield enrollment and eligibility required. Have a Cash App Card or sponsor a sponsored account, and qualify for Green. Sponsored accounts may earn the higher rate with sponsor approval. No monthly savings fee or minimum balance. Business accounts are ineligible. The current savings page displays 3.50%; an older learning article still displays 3.25%.
providers.protection: Conditional FDIC pass-through eligibility through program banks; limits aggregate with your other deposits at each bank.

fdic.label: FDIC · Conditional
fdic.summary: Eligible balances at program banks; card and pass-through requirements apply.

providers.name: Wealthfront
providers.requirements: 4.55% on up to $150,000 for 3 months: qualifying referral, funded investing account, and recurring deposits.
providers.details: Combines the 3.55% base with a 0.75-point referral boost and a 0.25-point recurring-deposit boost. The recurring boost requires an eligible funded investing account plus $1,000 monthly direct deposits or $2,500 recurring deposits; it has no balance cap or scheduled expiry. The referral boost lasts 3 months on up to $150,000. The separate 0.65-point new-client boost is an alternative to the referral boost, not an additional stack. No Cash Account fees.
providers.protection: Cash swept to FDIC-insured program banks. Wealthfront is a brokerage, not a bank; pass-through conditions and aggregate limits apply.

fdic.label: FDIC · Conditional
fdic.summary: Applies to cash swept to program banks, subject to program conditions.

providers.name: Marcus
providers.requirements: Refer a new customer, or open through a qualifying referral link. +1.00 percentage point for 3 months.
providers.details: Standard APY is 3.50%. Referral boosts apply to accounts where you are the primary owner. New customers must not have held a Marcus savings account or CD in the previous 12 months. Additional referrals extend the boost consecutively rather than increasing the rate. Account balance limits apply. After the boost, the then-current standard rate applies. No monthly fee or minimum deposit.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured bank deposit, subject to standard depositor, bank, and ownership-category limits.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: Goldman Sachs Bank USA; standard coverage limits apply.

providers.name: Ally
providers.requirements: No minimum opening deposit or monthly maintenance fee.
providers.details: Variable APY, currently the same across all balance tiers. Certain withdrawals and transfers are limited to 10 per statement cycle; consult account terms.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured bank deposit, subject to standard depositor, bank, and ownership-category limits.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: Ally Bank; standard coverage limits apply.

providers.name: Coinbase
providers.requirements: Coinbase One membership, starting at $4.99/month. Account and region eligibility apply.
providers.details: Publicly advertised USDC reward APY. Hold at least $1 USDC and meet trading and region eligibility. Coinbase One is required in the US; no non-member US base rate is offered. Your account shows the applicable rate, which can vary. Membership cost reduces net earnings.
providers.protection: Crypto rewards, not an insured bank deposit. Stablecoin depegging and platform custody risks apply.

fdic.label: Not FDIC insured
fdic.summary: USDC is a crypto asset, not an insured bank deposit.

providers.name: Kraken
providers.requirements: Up to 4.00% with Kraken+; up to 2.00% without. Enable Stablecoin Rewards.
providers.details: USDC rewards are available to eligible customers in the US, Canada, Australia, and UK. No holding lockup or USDC rewards fee; Kraken+ subscription costs may apply. Rates are variable and advertised as “up to.”
providers.protection: Not covered by FDIC or other deposit insurance. Stablecoin depegging and platform custody risks apply.

fdic.label: Not FDIC insured
fdic.summary: Stablecoin rewards are not covered by deposit insurance.

providers.name: E*TRADE
providers.requirements: New Premium Savings Accounts opened by January 10, 2027. Promotional APY applies for six months.
providers.details: Offered by Morgan Stanley Private Bank. No minimum opening deposit or monthly account fee. Promotion applies to eligible new accounts opened September 22, 2026–January 10, 2027, on balances up to $10 million; exceeding the cap may revert the entire balance to the standard rate. Existing accounts are ineligible. After six months, the variable base APY applies. Separate cash bonuses are excluded.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured bank deposit with an enhanced coverage program; depositor, ownership, and program-bank aggregation limits apply.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: Morgan Stanley Private Bank; enhanced coverage program conditions apply.

providers.name: Robinhood
providers.requirements: Robinhood Gold ($5/month) and enrollment for eligible cash in self-directed taxable investing accounts.
providers.details: Variable rate, effective September 17, 2026. Applies to eligible settled cash, including options collateral. Up to $10,000 of eligible uninvested cash stays in the Brokerage-Held Cash Program; amounts above that are swept to banks. Managed Robinhood Strategies accounts also earn this rate on swept cash without Gold. Fees reduce net earnings.
providers.protection: Protection depends on where cash is held. Brokerage-held cash is not an FDIC-insured bank deposit; bank-swept cash is subject to program-bank deposit coverage terms. Robinhood is not a bank.

fdic.label: FDIC · Mixed coverage
fdic.summary: Swept bank cash is eligible. Brokerage-held cash and options collateral are not FDIC insured.

providers.name: Aave
providers.requirements: Supply USDC to the Ethereum Core / Main market. Requires a compatible wallet and ETH for network fees.
providers.details: Deposit APY reported by Aave’s public API (the data behind Aave Pro) at 2026-10-08 14:50 UTC. This is one USDC market, not a protocol-wide rate. At this snapshot about 86% of the market’s supplied USDC was borrowed, which is what pushed the deposit rate up; it can fall quickly as borrowers repay or new deposits arrive. Rates change with market utilisation and governance parameters; other assets, networks, and markets have different yields. Network fees reduce net returns. Withdrawals depend on available liquidity and, if borrowing, collateral requirements.
providers.protection: No FDIC deposit insurance. Smart-contract, oracle, liquidity, and stablecoin depegging risks apply. Borrowing against supplied assets also introduces liquidation risk.

fdic.label: Not FDIC insured
fdic.summary: Onchain lending, not a bank deposit; smart-contract and liquidity risks apply.

providers.name: Barclays
providers.requirements: 3.50% below $250,000; 3.65% for $250,000–$1,000,000. No minimum to open or monthly maintenance fee.
providers.details: Variable APY based on the tier containing your end-of-day balance. The published tiers stop at $1 million; confirm treatment of larger balances with Barclays. This is a balance-tier rate, not a temporary boost. The separate Barclays Online Savings account pays 3.20% APY as of September 11, 2026. Cash signup bonuses are excluded from this comparison.
providers.protection: Barclays Bank Delaware is an FDIC member. The standard limit is $250,000 per depositor, per bank, per ownership category, including other deposits at the same bank. A higher APY balance tier does not increase insurance coverage; amounts above applicable limits may be uninsured.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: Standard FDIC limits apply; the $250k–$1m yield tier does not increase coverage.

providers.name: Axos Bank
providers.requirements: New Axos/UFB customers: open October 1–31. Up to 5.00% on first $49,999.99 for six statement cycles; qualifying checking activity required.
providers.details: Each month: $1,500 qualifying direct deposits and $1,500 average checking balance, OR $5,000 qualifying deposits and $5,000 average checking balance, by the 25th. Savings average balance must not exceed $249,999.99 for the boost. Other qualifying savings earns 4.21% up to $249,999.99 and 3.50% above; without qualification, 1.00%. No monthly maintenance fee. The opening cycle counts toward the six-cycle promotion. Additional deposit-program coverage has separate conditions.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured deposits at Axos Bank. The standard $250,000 limit per depositor, bank, and ownership category aggregates other deposits at the same bank.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: Axos Bank; standard coverage and same-bank aggregation limits apply.

providers.name: SoFi
providers.requirements: SoFi Plus costs $10/month. 4.50% applies to the first $20,000 in one eligible savings account; excess earns 3.30%.
providers.details: Without Plus, eligible direct deposit or $5,000 qualifying deposits every 31 days earns 3.30%; otherwise 0.80%. New customers opening September 3–December 31 can instead qualify for 4.20% for up to six months by meeting deposit requirements within 60 days and maintaining them. That boost cannot stack on the 4.50% tier. Joint-only accounts with two Plus subscribers can qualify for a $40,000 tier. Subscription fees reduce net earnings.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured deposits at SoFi Bank, N.A.. The standard $250,000 limit per depositor, bank, and ownership category aggregates other deposits at the same bank.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: SoFi Bank, N.A.; standard coverage and same-bank aggregation limits apply.

providers.name: Peak Bank
providers.requirements: $100 to open. New-account APY is 4.27% below $500,000; published tiers at $500,000+ earn 3.40%.
providers.details: No monthly maintenance fee. One account per customer; opening funds have a five-business-day hold. Advertised rates are for new accounts and may differ for existing customers. Rates are variable. Higher balance tiers do not increase FDIC protection.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured deposits at Idaho First Bank. The standard $250,000 limit per depositor, bank, and ownership category aggregates other deposits at the same bank.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: Idaho First Bank; standard coverage and same-bank aggregation limits apply.

providers.name: Pibank
providers.requirements: No minimum opening balance, monthly fees, or qualifying direct-deposit requirement.
providers.details: Earn interest starting at $0.01. Variable APY; Pibank is a brand of Intercredit Bank, so balances held under both names count toward the same FDIC limit.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured deposits at Intercredit Bank, N.A.. The standard $250,000 limit per depositor, bank, and ownership category aggregates other deposits at the same bank.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: Intercredit Bank, N.A.; standard coverage and same-bank aggregation limits apply.

providers.name: Newtek Bank
providers.requirements: New applications are paused; a waiting list is available. Published APY is for the existing savings product.
providers.details: The bank publishes 4.20% but currently does not accept new Personal High Yield Savings applications. Published account terms specify $100 to open, no ongoing minimum balance, $0.01 to earn interest, and up to six withdrawals/transfers per statement cycle. Do not treat the waiting list as an available account.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured deposits at Newtek Bank, N.A.. The standard $250,000 limit per depositor, bank, and ownership category aggregates other deposits at the same bank.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: Newtek Bank, N.A.; standard coverage and same-bank aggregation limits apply.

providers.name: CIT Bank
providers.requirements: Maintain $5,000+ and enroll with CITBOOST by October 31. 4.10% for six months; $100 to open, no monthly fee.
providers.details: Base APY is 3.75% at $5,000+, or 0.25% below $5,000. The 0.35-point boost follows the variable base rate and applies on balances up to $9,999,999. Eligible new and existing primary owners must enroll with the code. One offer per account/customer; exclusions include other above-standard rates, recent cash-bonus participation, trusts and custodial accounts. Returns to the then-current base after six months.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured deposits at First-Citizens Bank & Trust Company. The standard $250,000 limit per depositor, bank, and ownership category aggregates other deposits at the same bank.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: First-Citizens Bank & Trust Company; standard coverage and same-bank aggregation limits apply.

providers.name: Varo Bank
providers.requirements: Receive $1,000+ qualifying direct deposits and end the month with positive balances in all Varo accounts.
providers.details: Qualify this month to earn 3.75% on up to $5,000 next month; other savings earns 1.00%. Requires a Varo Bank Account. No monthly savings fee or minimum balance. US adult eligibility applies.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured deposits at Varo Bank, N.A.. The standard $250,000 limit per depositor, bank, and ownership category aggregates other deposits at the same bank.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: Varo Bank, N.A.; standard coverage and same-bank aggregation limits apply.

providers.name: Elevault
providers.requirements: No minimum deposit or fees. Interest is paid daily on balances up to $500,000; linked-account funding is capped at $2,500 a day.
providers.details: Variable APY of 4.34% (4.25% interest rate), which Elevault states is accurate as of May 5, 2026. Elevault is a product of Southern Bancorp. You must be a US resident aged 18 or older and scan a valid US driver’s license or state ID to enroll. You fund it by linking an account at another bank, and Elevault may close profiles left unfunded for 60 days. Balances above $500,000 do not earn interest. Elevault says VaultKeys (account and routing numbers it assigns to a Vault) let you move more than $2,500, with the sending bank setting the limit.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured deposits at Southern Bancorp Bank. The standard $250,000 limit per depositor, bank, and ownership category aggregates other deposits at the same bank.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: Southern Bancorp Bank; standard coverage and same-bank aggregation limits apply.

providers.name: EverBank
providers.requirements: $0 to open. New-account APY of 4.20% on all balances; no monthly maintenance fee or minimum balance.
providers.details: Variable APY for new accounts only, which EverBank states is accurate as of October 2, 2026; it may not apply to existing accounts. Interest compounds daily. The account opens only online or by phone, not at EverBank financial centers. Fees may reduce earnings.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured deposits at EverBank, N.A.. The standard $250,000 limit per depositor, bank, and ownership category aggregates other deposits at the same bank.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: EverBank, N.A.; standard coverage and same-bank aggregation limits apply.

providers.name: Happen Bank
providers.requirements: Deposit at least $250 per statement cycle to earn 4.20% on the full balance; otherwise 3.00%. $0 to open, no minimum balance, no account fees.
providers.details: Variable APYs accurate as of October 6, 2026. The rate is evaluated each statement cycle based on deposits in the previous cycle; interest payments, bonuses, credits, and refunds do not count as deposits. New accounts earn the LevelUp Rate until the first evaluation, which is the third statement cycle after opening. Multiple deposits can add up to the $250. Fees may reduce earnings.
providers.protection: FDIC-insured deposits at Happen Bank, N.A.. The standard $250,000 limit per depositor, bank, and ownership category aggregates other deposits at the same bank.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: Happen Bank, N.A.; standard coverage and same-bank aggregation limits apply.

providers.name: Openbank
providers.requirements: New Openbank customers who open by November 3, 2026: 3.80% plus a 0.35-point boost for six months (4.15%). $500 minimum to open.
providers.details: The boost is added to the variable standard APY for six months from opening, then the account earns the standard rate in effect. Accounts opened before September 23, 2026 are not eligible. Personal accounts only; cannot be combined with other Santander bonus offers. Fees may reduce earnings; see Openbank's fee schedule.
providers.protection: Openbank is part of Santander Bank, N.A., Member FDIC. Deposits at Santander Bank and Openbank are combined, not separately insured; the standard $250,000 limit per depositor, bank, and ownership category applies.

fdic.label: FDIC · Bank deposit
fdic.summary: Santander Bank, N.A.; Openbank and Santander deposits aggregate for coverage.
